name: cr722_3c_prepared_copy_is_cast_from_exile
why: CR 722.3a, c: Carnivorous Cultivator enters prepared, so its controller creates a copy in exile with only the prepare spell's characteristics, and may cast it: Enroot, a sorcery for {G}, searches for a land and puts it into the graveyard. A copy of a card leaves no card behind (CR 704.5e).
